'''Ducky''' was a [[DUM-series pit droid/Legends|DUM-series pit droid]] that served the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Podracer (profession)/Legends|podracer]] [[Sacha Swiftbird]]. As a result of [[Podracer/Legends|podracer]] crash, Swiftbird became injured and Ducky's neural net was scrambled, rendering the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] inoperable. Swiftbird subsequently gave up her career as a podracer and enlisted into the [[Antarian Rangers/Legends|Antarian Rangers]]; she took Ducky's remains with her, and the droid's chassis lay among a pile of droid parts inside the Rangers base [[Mountain Home]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Toprawa/Legends|Toprawa]]. In about [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]], Ducky's chassis was repaired by the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Technician/Legends|mech-tech]] [[Geri]] and used to temporarily house the [[Droid brain/Legends|droid brain]] of the droid [[I-5YQ]], whose own body had been destroyed.<ref name="TLJ" />
